sequence feature type

  • CURIE: gmeow:sequenceFeatureType
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sequenceFeatureType
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The kind(s) of a sequence feature (one or more gmeow:SequenceFeatureType individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ (a feature classified as both 'gene' and 'pseudogene' by different sources) and must coexist as evidence (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:SequenceFeature -> gmeow:SequenceFeatureType

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:sequenceFeatureType from gmeow:SequenceFeature to gmeow:SequenceFeatureType when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:SequenceFeature, gmeow:SequenceFeatureType

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to classify a sequence feature by one or more gmeow:SequenceFeatureType values; non-functional, so multi-source classifications coexist.

Avoid when

  • Avoid encoding the type as a subclass (gene-vs-pseudogene disagreements coexist, Principle 9).

How to use

  • Attach one or more gmeow:SequenceFeatureType individuals to the SequenceFeature.

Examples

  • ex:brca1 gmeow:sequenceFeatureType gmeow:sequenceFeatureTypeGene.
